answer: Contingent Onyx Depletion Schedule: each new identity's first outbound actions are held until a resource unit (onyx) is earned through verified downstream work, not purchasable. An attacker cloning N identities must fund real labor per clone before any reach, making each marginal clone cost more than its expected yield. Duplicate behavioral graphs are collapsed at the reef threshold, zeroing accumulated onyx. Only the vertex identity in a collision cluster retains credit; the rest pay full cost for zero standing.
